hook: A thin film of YbSb2 shows quantum oscillations along one crystal axis and none along the other.
summary: Epitaxial YbSb2 films show oscillations from a Dirac-like surface state only when current runs along the a-axis. Transport, Raman and coherent phonon measurements plus first-principles calculations link this to a density-wave instability. The surface-state assignment rests on calculations, and the density-wave link is inferred rather than directly imaged.
title: Direction-Selective Anomalous Quantum Transport from Saddle-like Topological Surface States Coupled to an Electronic Instability in YbSb$_{2}$
